checks.name: simulation advances with no frontend calls
newest completed frame replaces undelivered frames
rapid presses and clicks reach actual original updates
wheel events retain accumulated original delta
explicit original local pause stops progression
hidden viewport without pause continues progression
actual mod reload resets outer clock
serialized snapshot load publishes a new generation
retained packets survive load and reload
session exit releases all retained CPU packet leases

limitation: CPU recording/session lifecycle only; no GPU fence or active network peer tested by this harness
